data.body_html:
Renting a boat in Estepona without a licence is simpler than you think. In 2026, you can hire a fully crewed boat from Puerto Banús (just 15 minutes away) and explore the Costa del Sol coastline with zero paperwork. Our fleet includes small speedboats for up to 6 people and larger motor yachts for groups — all with a professional skipper, drinks, and snacks included. No experience needed, just show up and enjoy.

Below you’ll find the best options, prices, and what’s included for a no-license boat rental near Estepona.

Why Choose a No-Licence Boat Rental in Estepona?

If you don’t hold a Spanish boating licence (or any international equivalent), hiring a boat with a skipper is the only legal way to enjoy the sea. It’s also the most relaxing: you can sit back, sip a drink, and let someone else navigate. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, a 15-minute drive from Estepona, making it a convenient base for a day on the water.

Best Boats for No-Licence Rental Near Estepona

We offer two ideal options for small groups without a licence:

  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) — a compact motorboat perfect for couples or small families. Departs Puerto Banús.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) — a sporty option for up to 6 guests. Also departs Puerto Banús.

For larger groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) also include a skipper and are priced from €749 for 2 hours.

What’s Included in Every Charter

Every no-licence boat rental includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish VAT (21%)

No hidden extras. You only need to bring sunscreen, towels, and your camera.

Best Routes from Estepona

Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences. Popular options include:

  • Cala del Faro — a quiet cove west of Estepona, ideal for swimming.
  • Cala Cortés — another secluded spot with crystal-clear water.
  • Estepona Marina — cruise past the colourful old town and beach clubs.
  • Puerto Banús — head east to see the luxury yachts and Golden Mile.

You can also anchor for lunch at a chiringuito or simply drift and enjoy the views of La Concha mountain.

How to Book Your No-Licence Boat in Estepona

Booking is easy. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat. We’ll confirm availability and send you a payment link. Full payment is required to secure the booking. Cancellations made 48 hours or more before departure are fully refundable.
